materiality.rationale: SGLang v0.5.17 documents day-zero Kimi K3 and MiniMax-H3 serving, a Rust server front end, session-aware radix caching, and MoE/runtime changes; it matters because the W33 serving release links new model support to concrete runtime architecture, with release-note claims source-attributed.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: It gives the issue an infrastructure-level counterpart to model announcements: model availability depends on serving support, cache behavior, and the runtime path that the release changes.
